rules: eventId must be allowed by surface
payload must satisfy surface.eventSchemas[eventId] when present

invocationRegistry.phase1Rule: snapshot only; do not execute tools or write files from registry entries

patchPreview.phase2Rule: preview only; no JavaScript, no external URLs, no forms, no iframe, no tool execution

formEvent.phase3Rule: forms submit Event Envelopes using allowed event IDs only; accepted statePatch updates canonical surface state

toolRoute.phase4Rule: tool execution requires a registered enabled route and matching permission token

toolExecutionReceipt.stateRule: tool result is written to surface.state.toolResults[routeId]

generatedToolProposal.phase5Rule: saving creates a proposal record only; approval is required before any write

approvedGeneratedToolWrite.phase5Rule: approved writes must execute through a registered tool-gateway route

audiencePolicy.phase6Rule: private patches return content only to named recipients; others receive explicit policy response with no private content

lessonReplay.phase7Rule: promotion requires latest replay to pass

approvedPattern.phase7Rule: approved patterns are reusable lesson outputs

promotionGate.phase7Rule: failed promotion writes lesson.promotion.rollback; high-risk lesson cannot self-promote
